snippet.title: Your Meal, My Lord - Demo Available! Medieval Food Tasting Simulator
snippet.description:
Your Meal, My Lord is free to play in your browser on itch.io!
https://chaostheorygames.itch.io/your-meal-my-lord

Your Meal, My Lord is a medieval food-tasting sim. You are the royal food taster. Inspect every dish before it reaches the court. Or don't - Lord Snodtooth was going to die of something eventually, and his nephew has much better ideas about trade policy...

📰 Follow development:
LinkTree (all socials): https://linktr.ee/chaostheorygames
Studio: https://chaostheorygames.com
